title: input Always Returns String

bugs.explanation: `input()` always returns a string. Comparing a string to an integer with `>` raises `TypeError` in Python 3. Convert the input first: `int(age) > 18`.

title: max of Empty Sequence
code:
nums = []
print(max(nums))

bugs.explanation: `max()` on an empty sequence raises `ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence`. Pass a `default` keyword argument: `max(nums, default=0)` to safely handle empty inputs.

title: TypeError on Mixed Types
code:
items = [1, 'two', 3]
print(sum(items))

bugs.fix:
print(sum(x for x in items if isinstance(x, (int, float))))
# or: print(sum(int(x) for x in items if str(x).isdigit()))
bugs.explanation: `sum()` cannot add a string to a number — it raises `TypeError`. Either filter to only numeric items, or convert strings to numbers before summing.

title: Checking Anagram
String Palindrome Check
code:
def is_palindrome(s):
    s = s.lower().replace(' ', '')
    return s == s[::-1]

print(is_palindrome('A man a plan a canal Panama'))
